title: Three pathways to a level label on the X-ray
caption: LevelCheck, prior art, whose only classification is the click that labels the CT; SchwingCheck3D, which checks the CT's labels before surgery and carries them to the X-ray by a centroid fit; SchwingCheck2D, the default, which names or checks the bodies on AP and lateral panoramas with no CT. Heavy borders mark where the level is decided.

source.notes: A design, drawn from the white paper's section Three pathways; LevelCheck's figures are the publications', SchwingCheck's rates bordercall's synthetic records.
